intro: Afghanistan has over 40 million people from many ethnic groups, and one of the youngest populations in the world.

chapters.title: Peoples
text: Pashtuns are the largest group, followed by Tajiks, Hazaras, Uzbeks and others. Pashto and Dari (a form of Persian) are the main languages. Almost everyone is Muslim, mostly Sunni, with a Shia Hazara minority.
Millions of Afghans have lived as refugees, mostly in Pakistan and Iran.

chapters.title: Girls and women
text: Since 2021 the Taliban have banned girls from secondary school and university and limited women's work and travel, decisions condemned around the world.

keyTerms.meaning: The largest ethnic group in Afghanistan.
